description: Create, update or delete node pools in kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: append_tags
parameters.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object’s metadata. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: availability_zones
parameters.description: Availability zones for nodes. Must use VirtualMachineScaleSets AgentPoolType. Choices: 1 2 3

parameters.name: capacity_reservation_group_id
parameters.description: The Capacity Reservation Group ID.

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: cluster_name
parameters.description: The name of the kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of agents (VMs) to host docker containers.

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: enable_auto_scaling
parameters.description: Whether to enable auto-scaler. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enable_encryption_at_host
parameters.description: This is only supported on certain VM sizes and in certain Azure regions. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enable_fips
parameters.description: Whether enable FIPS node pool. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enable_node_public_ip
parameters.description: Some scenarios may require nodes in a node pool to receive theirown dedicated public IP addresses. A common scenario is for gaming workloads, where a console needs to make a direct connection to a cloud virtual machine to minimize hops. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enable_ultra_ssd
parameters.description: Whether to enable UltraSSD. Choices: false true

parameters.name: gpu_instance_profile
parameters.description: GPUInstanceProfile to be used to specify GPU MIG instance profile for supported GPU VM SKU. Choices: "MIG1g" "MIG2g" "MIG3g" "MIG4g" "MIG7g"

parameters.name: host_group_id
parameters.description: The Host Group ID. Sample as /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{RG_Name}/providers/Microsoft.Compute/hostGroups/{hostGroupName

parameters.name: kubelet_config
parameters.description: The Kubelet configuration on the agent pool nodes.

parameters.name: kubelet_disk_type
parameters.description: Determines the placement of emptyDir volumes, container runtime data root, and Kubelet ephemeral storage. Choices: "OS" "Temporary"

parameters.name: linux_os_config
parameters.description: The OS configuration of Linux agent nodes.

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: max_count
parameters.description: Maximum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

parameters.name: max_pods
parameters.description: Maximum number of pods that can run on a node.

parameters.name: min_count
parameters.description: Minimum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: AgentPoolMode represents mode of an agent pool. Choices: "System" "User"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the node agent pool.

parameters.name: network_profile
parameters.description: Network-related settings of an agent pool.

parameters.name: node_labels
parameters.description: Agent pool node labels to be persisted across all nodes in agent pool.

parameters.name: node_public_ip_prefix_id
parameters.description: The Azure Public IP prefix’s ID.

parameters.name: node_taints
parameters.description: The taints added to new nodes during node pool create and scale. For example as example, value:NoSchedule’.

parameters.name: orchestrator_version
parameters.description: Version of orchestrator specified when creating the managed cluster.

parameters.name: os_disk_size_gb
parameters.description: OS Disk Size in GB to be used to specify the disk size for every machine in this master/agent pool.

parameters.name: os_disk_type
parameters.description: The default is Ephemeral if the VM supports it and has a cache disk larger than the requested OSDiskSizeGB. Otherwise, defaults to Managed. May not be changed after creation. Choices: "Ephemeral" "Managed"

parameters.name: os_sku
parameters.description: Specifies an OS SKU. This value must not be specified if OSType is Windows. The os_sku=CBLMariner deprecated. Microsoft recommends that new deployments choose ‘AzureLinux’ instead. Choices: "Ubuntu" "AzureLinux" "Windows2019" "Windows2022"

parameters.name: os_type
parameters.description: OsType to be used to specify os type. Choices: "Linux" "Windows" "linux" "windows"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: pod_subnet_id
parameters.description: If omitted, pod IPs are statically assigned on the node subnet.

parameters.name: power_state
parameters.description: When an Agent Pool is first created it is initially Running. The Agent Pool can be stopped by setting this field to Stopped. A stopped Agent Pool stops all of its VMs and does not accrue billing charges. An Agent Pool can only be stopped if it is Running and provisioning state is Succeeded.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: proximity_placement_group_id
parameters.description: The ID for Proximity Placement Group.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: scale_down_mode
parameters.description: This also effects the cluster autoscaler behavior. If not specified, it defaults to Delete. Choices: "Delete" ← (default) "Deallocate"

parameters.name: scale_set_eviction_policy
parameters.description: This cannot be specified unless the scale_set_priority=Spot. If not specified, the default is Delete. Choices: "Delete" "Deallocate"

parameters.name: scale_set_priority
parameters.description: The Virtual Machine Scale Set priority. If not specified, the default is Regular. Choices: "Spot" "Regular"

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: security_profile
parameters.description: The security settings of an agent pool.

parameters.name: spot_max_price
parameters.description: Possible values are any decimal value greater than zero or -1. Indicates the willingness to pay any on-demand price.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the automation runbook. Use present to create or update a automation runbook and use absent to delete. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don’t allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn’t support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: type_properties_type
parameters.description: AgentPoolType represents types of an agent pool. Choices: "VirtualMachineScaleSets" "AvailabilitySet"

parameters.name: upgrade_settings
parameters.description: Settings for upgrading the agentpool.

parameters.name: vm_size
parameters.description: Size of agent VMs

parameters.name: vnet_subnet_id
parameters.description: VNet SubnetID specifies the VNet’s subnet identifier.

parameters.name: windows_profile
parameters.description: The Windows agent pool’s specific profile.

parameters.name: workload_runtime
parameters.description: Determines the type of workload a node can run. Choices: "OCIContainer" "WasmWasi"

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Add new node agent pool
  azure_rm_aksagentpool:
    resource_group: "{{ resource_group }}"
    cluster_name: aksfred01
    name: default-new
    count: 2
    vm_size: Standard_B2s
    type_properties_type: VirtualMachineScaleSets
    mode: System
    node_labels: {"release":"stable"}
    max_pods: 42
    orchestrator_version: 1.23.5
    availability_zones:
      - 1
      - 2
- name: Create a node agent pool with custom config
  azure_rm_aksagentpool:
    resource_group: "{{ resource_group }}"
    cluster_name: "min{{ rpfx }}"
    name: default-new2
    count: 1
    vm_size: Standard_B2s
    type_properties_type: VirtualMachineScaleSets
    mode: System
    node_labels: {"release":"stable"}
    max_pods: 42
    enable_auto_scaling: true
    min_count: 1
    max_count: 10
    orchestrator_version: 1.23.5
    availability_zones:
      - 1
    kubelet_config:
      cpu_manager_policy: static
      cpu_cfs_quota: true
      fail_swap_on: false
    linux_os_config:
      transparent_huge_page_enabled: madvise
      swap_file_size_mb: 1500
      transparent_huge_page_defrag: defer+madvise
- name: Delete node agent pool
  azure_rm_aksagentpool:
    resource_group: "{{ resource_group }}"
    cluster_name: aksfred01
    name: default-new
